determinism.method: two consecutive offline harness invocations on the same bytes, diff -q on the emitted JSON
determinism.randomness: the only stochastic element is the ACCEPTED frozen geometry non-vacuity control at its OWN frozen seed 0

freeze_ordering.rule: the freeze commit must be strictly earlier than any commit introducing a measurement artifact
freeze_ordering.declaration: No threshold, rubric, verdict contract or K was edited after any number was observed in this cycle. The only code changes after the freeze were the non-vacuity control rewrite (hand-rolled permutation replaced by the ACCEPTED geometry_gate.non_vacuity_control, which produced FEWER flips: 0 -> 1) and the cross-check discovery plumbing. Neither touched a threshold; the weaker control was kept because it is the accepted instrument's own reading.

scope_discipline.assertion: byte-identical before and after a full harness run; enforced by tests/frontier/frontier-rebuilt-packet-serve-audit/test_verdict_and_scoping.py::test_harness_writes_nothing_outside_the_team_namespace
scope_discipline.temp_writes: non-vacuity controls write bundle copies only under tempfile.mkdtemp() and delete them; nothing is written inside the repository
